purpose: Four distinct menu themes and navigation architectures for review before implementation
referencePolicy: Each atlas uses its direction's final title image as a style reference. Navigation architecture overrides generic positional suggestions in the shared content list.

01-starfall-codex.mechanism: Chapter rail and nested spellbook pages
01-starfall-codex.placement: Title: a left chapter rail. Interior screens: the rail remains narrow on the left, content opens as a large page on the right. Primary actions sit at the lower outside corner of the active page.
01-starfall-codex.movement: Selecting Play unfolds a right-hand mode page without replacing the chapter rail. Selecting a mode turns that page into setup; Begin descent opens the map. Academy opens a separate book of concepts. Back turns one page back; the rail can jump to another top-level chapter. Settings is one overlaid page that closes back to the same place.
01-starfall-codex.continuity: The current chapter, its page breadcrumb and the selected card stay visible. Returning from an overlay restores focus to the opener.
01-starfall-codex.prompt: NAVIGATION ARCHITECTURE — CHAPTER RAIL. Maintain a narrow elegant left chapter rail with Play, Academy, Library, Wardrobe, Settings. Content appears as the large right-hand page of a celestial book. Hierarchical breadcrumbs and page tabs within the content, main confirm buttons on the lower outer page corner. Use page-like layouts and a tiny next/back folio pair, not a generic full-page app dashboard.

02-rootglass-garden.mechanism: Spatial garden hub and destination rooms
02-rootglass-garden.placement: Title: Play and Academy are labelled entrances around the central tree, Library is an upper terrace, Wardrobe a lower-left pavilion. Continue is a floating capsule near the bottom center. Settings and Quit are small bottom-corner utility buttons; the profile is a gardener's tag at top right.
02-rootglass-garden.movement: Selecting a destination makes a short camera push into that room and reveals its focused task panel. Modes are portals along the garden path. Academy opens the tree's Root Map; a node opens a lesson worktable. A persistent Home leaf at bottom left returns to the same hub view. Back closes the current task panel or moves to the previous room.
02-rootglass-garden.continuity: The selected garden destination is still apparent in the backdrop. Last activity appears as Continue near the central tree; mastery grows visible roots.
02-rootglass-garden.prompt: NAVIGATION ARCHITECTURE — SPATIAL GARDEN. There is NO vertical global sidebar and NO repeated left button list. Use room-like views reached from labelled garden entrances. Content is a roomy floating cream worktable or clipboard over one distinct greenhouse location. A small Home leaf at bottom LEFT and a local Back tag are the only persistent navigation; the primary action is a broad button at bottom CENTER of the worktable. Use spatial destinations and rounded sign tags, not dashboard tiles in a left-nav app. Override shared screen descriptions' placement where necessary: mode choices are labelled portals distributed along a path; profiles are a gardener's register centered on screen; wardrobe is a central garden plinth with wrapped choice tags below it; Library opens a central shelf-and-reading-desk view; Settings opens a centered gardener's clipboard. Academy Root Map fills the tree and the lesson uses a central code worktable with task card above and test tray below.

03-signal-foundry.mechanism: Launch console, bottom tool dock and sliding inspectors
03-signal-foundry.placement: Title: two large central launch plates, Play and Academy; Continue is a status card at the right. Library, Wardrobe and Settings occupy a labelled bottom dock. Quit is a small top-right utility. Interior pages retain the dock and a compact top status bar.
03-signal-foundry.movement: Play expands its launch plate into a dispatch console. Modes are selected on a horizontal strip above the central preview. Configure slides in from the right; Launch takes over the console with the map. Library, Wardrobe and Settings slide up from their dock buttons as inspectors. Academy switches to the training console without changing the dock. Back retracts the inspector; Home restores the launch console.
03-signal-foundry.continuity: The bottom dock highlights the active station and the status bar carries the saved activity. Dock drawers retain local selection and scroll.
03-signal-foundry.prompt: NAVIGATION ARCHITECTURE — BOTTOM DOCK / DISPATCH CONSOLE. There is NO vertical left global navigation list. Keep a labelled horizontal tool dock at the BOTTOM, with Library, Wardrobe, Settings, Home. A thin TOP operational status bar carries mode and profile. Main activities launch from large central plates and modes use a horizontal selector strip. Configuration and inspection panels slide from the RIGHT or rise from the dock, visually shown as attached drawers with handles. Major action buttons align to the lower RIGHT of the central console, orange and clearly labelled. Override shared placement: Profiles is a right-hand personnel drawer, Wardrobe centers a full-body turntable with a horizontal wrapped selector at bottom, Library has a top filter band and a bottom dock, Settings is an operational inspector. 04-paper-circuit.mechanism: Horizontal chapter index and field-manual page turns
04-paper-circuit.placement: Title: the logo and paper-world illustration fill the upper portion. Across the bottom, four oversized chapter tabs read Play, Academy, Library and Wardrobe. A Continue bookmark hangs from the upper-right edge. Profile, Settings and Quit are small labelled margin controls.
04-paper-circuit.movement: A chapter tab opens a two-page field manual. The top chapter strip remains visible, while local contents are numbered in the page margin. Modes are a printed chapter spread; setup turns to the next folio. Academy opens a learning atlas, and exercises turn successive pages. A corner fold or Back goes to the previous folio. Switching chapters moves sideways through the manual and preserves each chapter's current page.
04-paper-circuit.continuity: Chapter tabs, folio numbers and the Continue bookmark make location and progress visible. Panels stay aligned to the print grid during transitions.
